reproduced.base: Validator returns 200 with {}; Node native accepts, Bun native rejects uppercase BOUNDARY.
reproduced.head: Node validator returns fields; Bun validator returns 400 and parseBody throws; parameter-name patch repairs both on Bun.

not_run: Deno and Cloudflare Workers were not run.
No rate of uppercase parameter names in production is established.
Historical peak-memory, latency and process-limit workloads were not repeated; grouping counterexamples use pinned functional cases and cache/parse-call observations.
strongest_argument_against: The actual parsing rejection belongs to Bun, whose native Request and Response fail too. The change repairs the media-type token, and its issue explicitly asks to keep parameter values intact. However, parameter names and parameter values are different; this probe never changes the value X.
